title: Concept: vcpkg dependency declared without a version floor
description: vcpkg.json declares a dependency named as a bare string, so its version comes from the baseline only, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The resolved version is decided by whichever baseline the registry happens to use, which the manifest never states.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through vcpkg.json (vcpkg).
risk: The resolved version is decided by whichever baseline the registry happens to use, which the manifest never states.
